doc: P2.06 corruption text filter (docs/07 §3.4 text pipeline: say chunk -> Safety.scan -> PronounFix -> Corruption.filter(stage, path) -> Typewriter; effect gates from docs/01 §3 stage table). `effects` pins each effect's kind, first stage and per-beat cap; a stage row only tunes the chance, so no data edit can unlock an effect below its documented gate. `strike.pairs` are the self-correction pairs (word -> what she really meant); `strike.mark` is U+0338 COMBINING LONG SOLIDUS OVERLAY, which the shipped Open Sans UI font (plus system fallback) renders as a slash through each glyph. `zalgo.marks` are the three combining marks the shipped font actually carries (U+0300, U+0301, U+0308); U+0332 in `bleed` is the combining low line. `reduced_motion.disable` lists the effects that exist only as visual jitter/smear and are switched off for the accessibility setting; the textual effects stay. `calmer_max_stage` is docs/02 §8's calmer mode cap (stage 3), so a calmer run never reaches zalgo/redaction/bleed/reverse. Read by game/llm/Corruption.gd; its DOCS_TABLE fallback holds the same values so a broken file degrades to the documented behaviour.
